targetedContentChecks.question: 2026-AM18
targetedContentChecks.evidence: Original page 19 and official preparation standards Article 316(3), (9), (10), Article 320(4). Small inland waters are interpolated from nearby land values; the minus-9999 rule applies to large lakes/sea in Article 317(5). Choice a/b conclusion agrees with the original.

targetedContentChecks.question: 2026-AM20
targetedContentChecks.evidence: Original page 21 and Article 448(2)(1)(ロ・ハ), Article 451(5), Article 464(1) agree on 1 second or less, dual frequency, 45 degrees or greater to terrain/object, and elevation values. Official option 3 is consistent.

targetedContentChecks.question: 2026-AM21
targetedContentChecks.evidence: Independently inspected original pages 22-23. On 1768x2500 page image the 1 km scale bar is approximately 421 px. b endpoints approximately (393,685) and (1267,819): 2.10 km and 2.68 degrees for 98.2 m height difference. e endpoints approximately (1382,1150) and (1040,882): horizontal 1.03 km and slope distance 1.04 km for 128.9 m height difference. Both b and e are false as the explanation states.
targetedContentChecks.measurementLimit: Manual pixel approximation, endpoints approximately +/-3 px; not a survey-grade measurement. Final text uses approximately 1.03 km horizontal / 1.04 km slope distance, consistent with the independent estimate.

targetedContentChecks.question: 2025-AM21
targetedContentChecks.evidence: Read drafts/owner4/q21-remeasurement.json and inspected figures/am-2025-q21-page5.png plus am-2025-q21-stairs-detail.png relative to that receipt. Distance/coordinate calculations for a-d are consistent with stated pixel coordinates, original landmarks, scale and elevations. The stair path is visually distinct and crosses more than ten 10 m contour intervals; e is false. Both b and e conflict with the statements, consistent with official answer 4.
targetedContentChecks.measurementLimit: Approximate map reading; no exact unlabeled endpoint elevations claimed. This scoped check does not certify every question in the dataset.

findings.title: Catalog gate does not gate public image files
findings.detail: 148 staged problem/answer images are inside Next public. No corresponding image-path publication check or deployment exclusion was present. Deploying this snapshot can expose original pages directly despite catalog ready-to-ingest and publicGo=0.
findings.requiredAction: Keep this worktree undeployed, or exclude/protect staged assets until publication acceptance. A false catalog gate alone is insufficient evidence of zero public assets. No deployment was performed by this reviewer.
findings.resolution: All 156 images now exist only under data/questions/sokuryoshi/assets; public/images/questions/sokuryoshi has zero files. Manifest stagedPath and NON_PUBLIC_STAGING_REQUIRES_PROMOTION explicitly separate future URLs from current serving. All staged hashes verified.

findings.title: Referenced end-of-book function tables are absent from rendered assets
findings.detail: The numbered question-page ranges are continuous, but 2026 AM PDF page 30 and 2026 PM question2 PDF page 22 contain function tables and are not rendered/referenced. AM21 and other originals instruct use of the end-of-book function table. Equivalent 2025 excluded tail pages need visual confirmation and inclusion where relevant. Source PDFs remain linked, so primary evidence is available externally, but this is not a self-contained complete original presentation.
findings.requiredAction: Add the shared function-table pages to the manifest and the applicable question UI, or provide a clearly labeled direct shared-table reference and qualify the completeness claim. Also distinguish omitted covers/blank pages from relevant appendices.
findings.resolution: Eight tail pages added as referenceTables (2025 AM13-14, 2026 AM30-31, 2025 PM18-19, 2026 PM22-23). Applicable question imageUrls include the shared reference pages. Blank final pages may be retained harmlessly alongside function tables.

findings.title: User-visible AM processing attribution understates paraphrasing
findings.location: questions.json sourceAttribution (for example 2026 AM18 and AM20)
findings.detail: Attribution says edited text had whitespace/line breaks normalized, but the actual stems condense and paraphrase original sentences. Source-branches correctly calls it edited text; that distinction is not equally explicit in the displayed attribution.
findings.requiredAction: State that study text is summarized/paraphrased, while original wording and figures are preserved in original-page images. Do not describe the edited text as a verbatim transcript.
findings.resolution: All 56 AM sourceAttribution fields now say study text includes summarization/paraphrasing and direct readers to original-page images for original wording, conditions and figures.
